articles.title_en: Russia will allow unrestricted sales of civilian gas masks for the first time in over 30 years
articles.lead_en: Starting March 1, 2027, Russia will allow certified civilian gas masks, including models for children, to be sold without restrictions, the Emergency Situations Ministry said.

articles.title_en: Five injured after Ukrainian drone attack on Russia’s Sochi
articles.lead_en: Ukraine’s military launched a drone attack on Krasnodar Krai overnight on September 14. In Sochi, the regional emergency response headquarters reported that five people, including a child, were injured by “falling drone debris”.
